posts.body:
Getting a personalized workout plan used to mean hiring a trainer or following a generic PDF. Today, a **free AI workout generator** can give you a custom plan in seconds—with **no signup** required.

## No signup, no subscription

Many apps force you to sign up before you can do anything useful. With a **free AI workout generator** that requires **no signup**, you can try your first workout immediately. If you like it, you can unlock more with a one-time payment—no recurring subscription.
